title: Config
description: The configuration of a zenith project.

files.description: Which files to scan for imports.

analysis.description: Defaults that apply to every contract.

contracts.description:
The architecture contracts, keyed by id. Ids are used by
`--contract`, the baseline and `zenith-ignore` comments.

FilesConfig.description: Which files to scan for imports.

include.description:
Globs of files to scan, relative to the project root. Defaults to
every JavaScript and TypeScript file.

exclude.description:
Globs of files and directories to skip, in addition to the default
excludes (`node_modules`, `dist`, `.next`, ...).

respect_gitignore.description:
Whether to skip files ignored by `.gitignore`, `.ignore` and the
global git excludes.

tsconfig.description:
`"auto"` (the default) uses the nearest `tsconfig.json` of each file,
`"off"` ignores them, and any other value is the path of a single
`tsconfig.json` to use for every file.

conditions.description:
Condition names used for `exports` maps, in addition to nothing: when
set, this replaces the default list.

main_fields.description: `package.json` fields that point at a package's entry point.

extensions.description: Extensions to try when a specifier has none, in order.

alias.description:
Bundler-only aliases: a specifier prefix and the path, relative to
the project root, that it maps to.

ignore_unresolved.description:
Specifier globs that are expected not to resolve, e.g. `"/*"` for
files served from a public directory, or `"virtual:*"`.

AnalysisConfig.description: Defaults that apply to every contract.

exclude_kinds.description:
Import kinds that contracts ignore unless they set their own
`exclude_kinds`.

ImportKind.description:
How an import is made. Contracts can exclude imports of given kinds, e.g.
to exempt type-only imports.

oneOf.description:
A static value import or re-export: `import x from "s"`, `import "s"`,
`export * from "s"`.

A type-only import that is erased at runtime: `import type`, an
import whose specifiers are all `type`, or `typeof import("s")`.
A dynamic `import("s")` with a literal specifier.
A CommonJS `require("s")` or TypeScript `import x = require("s")`.

path.description: The path of the baseline file, relative to the project root.

stale.description: How to report baseline entries whose import no longer exists.

StaleLevel.description: How to report stale baseline entries.

oneOf.description: Stale entries fail the check, so the baseline can only shrink.
Stale entries are reported as warnings.

ContractConfig.description: One architecture contract. The `type` key selects the kind of contract.

oneOf.description: Higher layers may import lower layers, never the reverse.
The `from` modules must not import the `to` modules.
The modules must not depend on one another.
Only the allowed importers may directly import the modules.
No dependency cycles between the modules.
The modules may only be imported through their entry points.

Severity.description: How severe a broken contract is.

oneOf.description: A broken contract fails the check.
A broken contract is reported without failing the check.

AlertLevel.description: How to report an `ignore_imports` entry that matches nothing.

LayerConfig.description:
A layer of a `layers` contract: `"a"`, `"a | b"` (independent
siblings), `"a : b"` (siblings that may import each other) or `"(a)"`
(optional), or a table to mark the layer as closed.

closed.description:
A closed layer may not be bypassed: layers above it may not
import layers below it.

SelectorConfig.description:
A selector of modules: a path glob (`web/src/domains/*`), a workspace
package (`pkg:@acme/*`), an external package (`npm:react`), a builtin
(`node:*`), or a table for the advanced forms.

anyOf.description: A selector with exclusions or a directive filter.

SelectorTable.description: The table form of a selector.

except.description: Selectors whose members are removed from each matched module.

directive.description:
Keep only files with this directive in their prologue, e.g.
`"use client"`.

name.description: A human-readable title for output. Defaults to the id.

severity.description: `"warn"` reports the contract without failing the check.

exclude_kinds.description:
Import kinds to ignore, e.g. `["type"]`. Defaults to
`[analysis] exclude_kinds`.

unmatched_ignore_imports.description: How to report `ignore_imports` entries that match nothing.

guidance.description: Text printed under the violations, e.g. how to fix them.

layers.description: The layers, ordered from highest to lowest.

containers.description:
If set, layers are relative to each container, and each container
is checked separately.

exhaustive.description: Every child of every container must be declared as a layer.

exhaustive_ignores.description: Child names exempt from the exhaustiveness check.
